caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, ornate urn placed centrally on a plain, light beige background with no other objects or scenery present. The urn features a broad, shallow bowl with a scalloped edge and two large, symmetrical handles extending horizontally outward from either side. The handles are decorated with elaborate scrollwork and ornate patterns. The base of the urn is supported by a pedestal, which is adorned with sculpted reliefs, including an animal form resembling a goat or ram with prominent horns on one side. The surfaces of the urn and pedestal are rendered in shades of dark gray with subtle hints of brown, purple, and green, creating a metallic effect. At the bottom, there is a square plinth partially surrounded by grass. The artist's monogram and a small inscription are visible just below the object, centered on the page.
title: Urn
